title: RTPS: Dissect PID_CHECKSUM_PROPERTY (0x9000)
description:
PID_CHECKSUM_PROPERTY (0x9000) is a vendor-specific parameter sent in
SPDP DATA(p) announcements to advertise a participant's checksum
negotiation properties: computed CRC kind, allowed CRC bitmask, and
require-CRC flag. Currently used by RTI Connext DDS Micro (vendor
01.10).

AI-Assisted: yes (Copilot)

notes.body:
[crc_not_dissected-trimmed.pcapng](/uploads/780a23137d55800333955efbcb6d4eee/crc_not_dissected-trimmed.pcapng)

Note that the CRC is correctly dissected. Wireshark is pointing out that the CRC is incorrect, which is likely why they were using Wireshark to debug in the first place.
